title: Would you trust an AI trading tool more if it told you NOT to enter a trade?
author: xMavchartAI
selftext:
I’ve been building xMav Chart AI, an app that analyzes trading chart screenshots using AI.  
One thing I’ve noticed from trader feedback is that people don’t necessarily want an AI that always says BUY or SELL.  
Sometimes the most useful answer might be WAIT.  
But here’s what I’m curious about:  
If you analyzed an XAUUSD or BTCUSD chart and the AI disagreed with your setup, would you actually reconsider your trade?  
Or would you just ignore the AI and follow your original analysis?  
Personally, I think AI should provide a second opinion, explain its reasoning and highlight potential risks rather than blindly confirm what a trader wants to hear.  
I’d genuinely like to hear how other traders approach this.  
**Would you trust an AI that sometimes tells you to stay out of the market?**
